enums.name: ClaimName
enums.description: Wire names of the well-known token claims the framework extracts from a verified payload. Adopting these constants replaces hand-written claim-key literals in the framework auth code.

values.name: ClientId
values.description: OAuth2 client identifier the token was issued to.

values.name: Roles
values.description: Role names assigned to the principal.

values.name: Aud
values.description: Audience(s) the token is intended for.

values.name: Exp
values.description: Expiration time in seconds since the Unix epoch (RFC 7519 NumericDate).

enums.name: PrincipalKind
enums.description: The recognized kinds of authenticated principal. Adopting these constants replaces hand-written principal-kind literals in the framework auth code.

values.name: User
values.description: A bearer/OIDC principal: claims come from a validated JWT or an RFC 7662 token-introspection response.

values.name: ApiKey
values.description: A static API-key principal: a fixed subject and client identifier with statically granted scopes and no expiry.

enums.name: AuthDecision
enums.description: The outcome label for an authorization check. The values double as the metric counter keys and the "decision" log attribute, so the Go and TypeScript frameworks share one vocabulary for dashboards and log queries.

values.name: Allow
values.description: The request satisfied every access rule and proceeds to the handler (HTTP 200).

values.name: DenyUnauthenticated
values.description: No verified identity was present, so the request is rejected before any rule check (HTTP 401).

values.name: DenyClient
values.description: The authenticated principal is not an accepted client, issuer, audience, or principal kind (HTTP 403).

values.name: DenyScope
values.description: The principal is missing a required scope (HTTP 403).

values.name: DenyRole
values.description: The principal is missing a required role (HTTP 403).

values.name: DenyGuard
values.description: A custom guard function rejected the request (HTTP 403).

structs.name: Claims
structs.description: The well-known claims the framework extracts from a verified token payload into typed fields (go/framework/http ClaimsFromMap). Every field is optional on the wire; unrecognized claims travel out-of-band in an extra map.

fields.name: client_id
fields.description: OAuth2 client identifier the token was issued to.

fields.name: roles
fields.description: Role names assigned to the principal.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Scopes granted to the principal, extracted from the "scope" claim.

claims.name: iss
claims.description: Issuer: who issued the token. Bearer-token validation asserts it against the expected issuer when one is configured.

claims.name: client_id
claims.description: OAuth2 client identifier the token was issued to.

claims.name: roles
claims.description: Role names assigned to the principal; a space-delimited string is also accepted on the wire.

claims.name: scope
claims.description: Scopes granted to the principal; the OAuth2 space-delimited string form is also accepted on the wire.

claims.name: aud
claims.description: Audience(s) the token is intended for; a single string is also accepted per RFC 7519. Asserted when an expected audience is configured.

claims.name: exp
claims.description: Expiration time in seconds since the Unix epoch (RFC 7519 NumericDate). Bearer-token validation rejects tokens without it by default.

principalKinds.name: user
principalKinds.description: A bearer/OIDC principal: claims come from a validated JWT or an RFC 7662 token-introspection response.

principalKinds.name: apikey
principalKinds.description: A static API-key principal: a fixed subject and client identifier with statically granted scopes and no expiry.

discovery.title: Identity Contract
discovery.summary: The consumer-side identity vocabulary of the Putnami frameworks: the well-known token claims they extract and the principal kinds they recognize.
